name: Air-Fryer Sweet Potato Wedges with White Bean Dip
ingredients: 200 g sweet potato, cut into wedges
½ tsp each smoked paprika, cumin and garlic powder
Dip: ¾ cup cooked white beans, 1 garlic clove, juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp olive oil, 2 tbsp water, salt, ¼ tsp cumin
steps: Toss the wedges with the oil, spices and salt.
Cook the wedges for 20–25 minutes, shaking every 7 minutes, until tender inside and crisp outside.
Blend the dip ingredients until smooth.
Serve the wedges with the dip and parsley.
note: The bean dip adds protein and fibre, and replaces mayonnaise-based dips.
